{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Autumn evening, neat social band, so a refined knit with a skirt, a textured jacket and neat ankle boots, with a light outer layer for the cool weather.

Fitted fine-knit crew-neck sweater, hip-length, deep burgundy #6D2B3A, merino wool
Midi A-line skirt, falling just below the knee, soft flowing pleats, charcoal #3B3F45, crepe
Textured blazer, slightly tailored, hip-length, camel #B88A5A, wool bouclé
Heeled ankle boots, almond toe, block heel, black #1C1C1E, smooth leather
Structured small shoulder bag, black #1C1C1E, leather
Delicate drop earrings, gold #C9A24B, metal
Thin leather belt, black #1C1C1E, leather
Lightweight scarf, loosely draped, warm cream #EFE3CF, fine wool

This outfit suits a restaurant date because the burgundy knit brings warmth and a soft romantic note, and it looks lovely in candlelit, artificial light. The flowing midi skirt and heeled boots keep the look feminine and polished without being too dressy for a casual restaurant. The camel bouclé blazer adds texture and keeps you warm on an autumn evening, and it can be taken off at the table. The neutral base with gold accents makes the whole look cohesive and easy to wear."}
